# Three.js

`three.module.js` and `three.core.js` are the unmodified ES modules from Three.js **0.187.0**, copied from the repository's existing pinned vendor files. MIT license: `THREE-LICENSE`.

- [Upstream repository](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js)
- [Pinned package](https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.187.0.tgz)

The app imports these local modules directly; no CDN or build is required.
